newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: C.BANK PRESENTS ITS NEW PUBLICATION.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK PRESENTS ITS NEW PUBLICATION.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank presented on Wednesday its new financial journal, Monetary Studies, which focuses on banking and economic issues.
"The magazine will write on all the important issues since many things in the state depend on its monetary policy," Bank of Lithuania Govenor Reinoldijus Sharkinas said during the presentation.
Sharkinas said the magazine will be also used to respond to stories in the foreign mass media on Lithuania's monetary plolicy and the future of the litas.

The editor of the magazine, Jonas Niaura, the deputy chairman of the Bank of Lithuania, said the publication will pay major attention to monetary policy, banking, and integration into European banking structures.
"The articles in the magazine will not be censored and will express not only the official opinion of the Bank of Lithuania," Niaura said.
"We want to present not only the figures but also to explain the logic of the decisions taken," the head of the bank's policy department, Gitanas Nauseda, said.
The bank plans one or two issues of the magazine this year and to publish it on a more regular basis in 1998.
The magazine will also be published in English.
